title: Ravena — Economia
description: Painel da economia (Zinthos, Petalitas, Runas). Fonte: analytics.db publicado de hora em hora pela ravena-ai. Mapeamento motivo → tipo e nomes em src/services/EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js. O analytics.db guarda epoch em ms; o frser-sqlite-datasource lê colunas de tempo em segundos, por isso o / 1000 nos SELECT.

panels.title: Estado
Confiança: de quando são os dados (agora)
panels.description: Até que hora cheia cada fonte está carregada. A carga roda no minuto 5, então o atraso normal fica entre ~0,1 e ~1,1 h; acima de 2 h a carga está falhando (ver Último erro, vazio quando a última carga deu certo). Motivos sem mapear: motivos do extrato que a ravena ainda não sabe classificar (Diagnóstico mostra quais). Petalitas: o Jardim ainda não tem extrato, só o saldo. Limites de cor PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3))
SELECT cur.nome AS "Fonte",
  (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1) / 1000 AS "Dados até",
  ROUND((CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
         - (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1)) / 3600000.0, 1) AS "Atraso (h)",
  CASE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), -1)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'com extrato' WHEN 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE 'sem dados' END AS "Extrato",
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.reason) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'unknown' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Motivos sem mapear (7 dias)",
  COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN ok = 0 THEN error END FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS "Último erro"
FROM cur ORDER BY cur.ordem

panels.title: Veredito por moeda (últimos 7 dias)
panels.description: Situação = o pior entre: crescimento da massa na semana (ok até 1%, atenção até 3%, agir acima, nos dois sentidos; comparado com o retrato de 7 a 9 dias antes, senão 'sem dados'), moeda sem origem na semana em % da massa (0,1% / 0,5%) e em % do criado (1% / 5%), e motivo sem mapear no extrato (pelo menos atenção). 'Por quê' lista todo critério que não está ok. 'Sem origem' mostra o critério pior; os dois valores (% do criado e % da massa) ficam em colunas ocultas (Inspecionar → Dados). Dobra em = semanas para a massa dobrar no ritmo desta semana (ln 2 / ln(1+g)). Moeda sem origem = Δ massa − Σ(entradas − saídas) do extrato: positivo apareceu sem linha no extrato, negativo sumiu. Zinthos e Runas já nascem em 'agir' por buracos de extrato conhecidos (give-all, sobra do confisco, créditos de Runas sem linha); é esperado. Limites de cor PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3)), snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances b
  WHERE NOT (b.holders IS NULL AND b.ts < COALESCE((SELECT CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) FROM meta m
                                                    WHERE m.key = 'mass_reconstructed_before:' || b.currency), 0))
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT currency, d, ts AS ta, total AS t0,
         LEAD(d) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS d_next,
         LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS tb,
         LEAD(total) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS t1
  FROM op
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.d_next - dl.d AS dias, dl.t1 AS total_fim,
         (dl.t1 - dl.t0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency AND f.kind <> 'non_monetary'
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE dl.tb IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
),
b AS (
  SELECT cur.currency, cur.nome, cur.ordem,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa,
    (SELECT ts FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS ts_dados,
    -- base do crescimento: retrato com 7 a 9 dias antes do último; sem ele, sem dados (nada de "dobra em" falso)
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency
       AND x.ts <= (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM balances y WHERE y.currency = cur.currency AND y.ts <= $__to) - 604800000
       AND x.ts >= (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM balances y WHERE y.currency = cur.currency AND y.ts <= $__to) - 9 * 86400000
       ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa_antes,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('creation', 'destruction')
       AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS criado,
    (SELECT SUM(so) FROM x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency
       AND x.d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__to - 604800000 AND x.d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to) AS so7,
    (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT l.label FROM reason_labels l WHERE l.currency = f.currency AND l.reason = f.reason), f.reason) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'creation'
       AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to GROUP BY f.reason ORDER BY SUM(f.amount_in) DESC LIMIT 1) AS maior_fonte,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.reason) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'unknown' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS unk,
    COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), 1) AS avail
  FROM cur
),
c AS (
  SELECT *,
    (massa - massa_antes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ABS(massa_antes), 0) AS g,
    100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(ABS(massa), 0) AS so_massa,
    100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(criado, 0) AS so_criado
  FROM b
),
n AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN g IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ABS(g) * 100 <= 1 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(g) * 100 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS lv_g,
    CASE WHEN avail = 0 OR so7 IS NULL OR so_massa IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(so_massa) < 0.1 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(so_massa) < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS lv_sm,
    CASE WHEN avail = 0 OR so7 IS NULL OR so_criado IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(so_criado) < 1 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(so_criado) < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS lv_sc,
    CASE WHEN unk > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lv_u
  FROM c
),
v AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(COALESCE(lv_sm, -1), COALESCE(lv_sc, -1)) AS lv_so,
    CASE WHEN lv_g IS NULL AND lv_sm IS NULL AND lv_sc IS NULL AND lv_u = 0 THEN -1
      ELSE MAX(COALESCE(lv_g, -1), COALESCE(lv_sm, -1), COALESCE(lv_sc, -1), lv_u) END AS lv
  FROM n
)
SELECT nome AS "Moeda",
  CASE lv WHEN 0 THEN 'ok' WHEN 1 THEN 'atenção' WHEN 2 THEN 'agir' ELSE 'sem dados' END
    || CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN ' · sem extrato' ELSE '' END AS "Situação",
  CASE WHEN lv <= 0 THEN '—' ELSE
    CASE WHEN lv_g >= 1 THEN 'crescimento' ELSE '' END
    || CASE WHEN lv_so >= 1 THEN CASE WHEN lv_g >= 1 THEN ' + ' ELSE '' END || 'sem origem' ELSE '' END
    || CASE WHEN lv_u >= 1 THEN CASE WHEN lv_g >= 1 OR lv_so >= 1 THEN ' + ' ELSE '' END || 'motivo sem mapear' ELSE '' END END AS "Por quê",
  ROUND(100.0 * g, 2) AS "Crescimento (%)",
  CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN ROUND(ln(2) / ln(1 + g), 1) END AS "Dobra em (semanas)",
  CASE WHEN lv_so IS NULL OR lv_so < 0 THEN NULL
       WHEN COALESCE(lv_sc, -1) >= COALESCE(lv_sm, -1) THEN printf('%.2f%% do criado', so_criado)
       ELSE printf('%.3f%% da massa', so_massa) END AS "Sem origem",
  ROUND(so_criado, 2) AS "Sem origem (% do criado)",
  ROUND(so_massa, 3) AS "Sem origem (% da massa)",
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE maior_fonte END AS "Maior fonte",
  ts_dados / 1000 AS "Dados até"
FROM v ORDER BY ordem

panels.title: De onde vem e para onde vai — ${moeda} (últimos 7 dias)
panels.description: Extrato da moeda escolhida (seletor no topo): os 8 motivos que mais mexeram no saldo (|líquido|), mais todo motivo sem mapear, e o resto somado em 'Outros'. Tipo vem do mapeamento da ravena (EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js): 'Sem mapeamento' = motivo novo que alguém precisa mapear; 'Fora do dinheiro' (ex.: waifu confiscada na taxa de hospedagem) não mexe no saldo e só mostra a contagem. Petalitas: sem extrato.

targets.queryText:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.reason, f.kind, COALESCE((SELECT l.label FROM reason_labels l WHERE l.currency = f.currency AND l.reason = f.reason), f.reason) AS motivo,
    SUM(amount_in) AS ent, SUM(amount_out) AS sai, SUM(amount_in - amount_out) AS liq, SUM(tx_count) AS tx
  FROM flows_hourly f
  WHERE f.currency = '${moeda}' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
  GROUP BY f.reason, f.kind
),
k AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN 0 ELSE ABS(liq) END DESC, tx DESC) AS pos FROM r
),
shown AS (SELECT * FROM k WHERE pos <= 8 OR kind = 'unknown'),
rest AS (SELECT * FROM k WHERE NOT (pos <= 8 OR kind = 'unknown'))
SELECT "Motivo", "Tipo", "Entrou", "Saiu", "Líquido", "Transações" FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS grp, pos, motivo AS "Motivo", CASE kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 'Criação' WHEN 'destruction' THEN 'Destruição'
    WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Transferência' WHEN 'exchange_in' THEN 'Câmbio (entrada)'
    WHEN 'exchange_out' THEN 'Câmbio (saída)' WHEN 'non_monetary' THEN 'Fora do dinheiro'
    ELSE 'Sem mapeamento' END AS "Tipo",
    CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE ent END AS "Entrou",
    CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE sai END AS "Saiu",
    CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE liq END AS "Líquido",
    tx AS "Transações"
  FROM shown
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1, 0, 'Outros (' || COUNT(*) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN ' motivo)' ELSE ' motivos)' END, '—',
    SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN 0 ELSE ent END), SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN 0 ELSE sai END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN 0 ELSE liq END), SUM(tx)
  FROM rest HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) ORDER BY grp, pos

panels.title: Últimas mudanças: antes e depois
panels.description: Ficha de cada mudança registrada (scripts/economy-annotate.js): criado por dia nos 7 dias antes e depois (depois = até a última hora carregada, no máximo 7 dias; vazio antes de 1 dia). Mudança sem moeda usa a moeda do seletor. A ficha completa (destruído, massa, jogadores) fica na seção 'Mudanças: ficha de antes e depois'.

targets.queryText:
WITH a AS (SELECT ts, currency, label, COALESCE(currency, '${moeda}') AS c FROM annotations WHERE ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 6),
m AS (
  SELECT a.*,
    MAX(0, MIN(604800000, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(hour) + 3600000 FROM flows_hourly z WHERE z.currency = a.c), a.ts) - a.ts)) / 86400000.0 AS dias,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = a.c AND f.kind = 'creation' AND f.hour >= a.ts - 604800000 AND f.hour < a.ts) / 7.0 AS cri_a,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = a.c AND f.kind = 'creation' AND f.hour >= a.ts AND f.hour < a.ts + 604800000) AS cri_d_tot,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = a.c AND f.kind = 'destruction' AND f.hour >= a.ts - 604800000 AND f.hour < a.ts) / 7.0 AS des_a,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = a.c AND f.kind = 'destruction' AND f.hour >= a.ts AND f.hour < a.ts + 604800000) AS des_d_tot,
    (SELECT total FROM balances b WHERE b.currency = a.c AND b.ts <= a.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa_na,
    (SELECT total FROM balances b WHERE b.currency = a.c AND b.ts <= a.ts + 604800000 ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa_dep,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM player_daily d WHERE d.currency = a.c AND d.day >= a.ts - 604800000 AND d.day < a.ts) / 7.0 AS jog_a,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM player_daily d WHERE d.currency = a.c AND d.day >= a.ts AND d.day < a.ts + 604800000) AS jog_d_tot
  FROM a
),
r AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN dias >= 1 THEN cri_d_tot / dias END AS cri_d, CASE WHEN dias >= 1 THEN des_d_tot / dias END AS des_d
  FROM m
)
SELECT ts / 1000 AS "Quando", CASE r.c WHEN 'zinthos' THEN 'Zinthos' WHEN 'petalitas' THEN 'Petalitas' ELSE 'Runas' END || CASE WHEN currency IS NULL THEN ' (todas)' ELSE '' END AS "Moeda", label AS "O que mudou",
  ROUND(cri_a) AS "Criado/dia antes", ROUND(cri_d) AS "Criado/dia depois",
  ROUND(100.0 * (cri_d - cri_a) / NULLIF(cri_a, 0), 1) AS "Δ criado (%)", ROUND(dias, 1) AS "Dias depois"
FROM r ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Sem origem por dia — Zinthos (período selecionado)
panels.description: Por dia econômico (04:00 BRT): Δ massa entre o primeiro retrato do dia e o do próximo dia com retrato − Σ(entradas − saídas) das horas entre eles (linhas fora do dinheiro não entram), em % da massa. Cor nos dois sentidos: positivo = moeda apareceu sem linha no extrato, negativo = sumiu (verde até 0,1%, amarelo até 0,5%, vermelho acima). Dia sem retrato não some: o intervalo fica no último dia com retrato (ver 'Dias no intervalo' na dica). O dia mais recente só aparece quando o seguinte tem retrato. Limites de cor PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances b
  WHERE NOT (b.holders IS NULL AND b.ts < COALESCE((SELECT CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) FROM meta m
                                                    WHERE m.key = 'mass_reconstructed_before:' || b.currency), 0))
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT currency, d, ts AS ta, total AS t0,
         LEAD(d) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS d_next,
         LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS tb,
         LEAD(total) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS t1
  FROM op
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.d_next - dl.d AS dias, dl.t1 AS total_fim,
         (dl.t1 - dl.t0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency AND f.kind <> 'non_monetary'
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE dl.tb IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
)
SELECT (d * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(100.0 * so / NULLIF(ABS(total_fim), 0), 3) AS "% da massa", so AS "Sem origem", dias AS "Dias no intervalo"
FROM x
WHERE currency = 'zinthos' AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__from AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to
ORDER BY d
